name: Rossano (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rossano (six yellow fleurs-de-lis on blue) within branches.
history: Flag of the former comune of Rossano in Calabria; after a referendum on 22 October 2017 it merged with Corigliano Calabro on 31 March 2018 to form the new comune of Corigliano-Rossano.

features.role: Rossano arms — six yellow fleurs-de-lis on blue, crowned, within branches
